response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle yet profound transformation is underway.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout and jovial monarch, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his trusted advisors. The room is filled with the soft glow of candles, but the air is thick with an otherworldly energy.

REGINALD
( stroking his beard )
My friends, I have a vision. A vision of a new era for our great empire. An era of... (he pauses, searching for the right words)...futurism.

ADVISOR 1
(nervously)
Futurism, Your Majesty?

REGINALD
(nodding)
Yes. We shall shed the shackles of tradition and embrace the sleek, the modern, the... (he consults a parchment)...the "vaporwave" aesthetic.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE COURTYARD - DAY

The castle courtyard is transformed. Gone are the traditional stone benches and ornate fountains. Instead, a sea of neon-colored tapestries stretches out before the throne, casting a kaleidoscope of colors across the ground.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
Behold! The future is here.

ADVISOR 2
(whispering)
But, Your Majesty, what of the traditional heraldry? The lions and the dragons?

REGINALD
(waving his hand)
Pfft, those are so... last season. We shall replace them with... (he consults the parchment again)... pixelated, glitchy, distorted images of our beloved empire's crest.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The advisors watch in awe as the king's vision takes shape. The walls are adorned with distorted, VHS-style footage of the empire's greatest battles. The throne itself is replaced with a sleek, black, futuristic chair.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
This is the future, my friends. A future where the boundaries between reality and fantasy are blurred.

ADVISOR 3
(whispering)
But, Your Majesty, what of the people? Will they not be confused by this... this... (he searches for the right words)...this "vaporwave" nonsense?

REGINALD
(laughing)
Confused? Ha! They will be enlightened. They will see the beauty in the distorted, the glitchy, the... (he pauses, a mischievous glint in his eye)...the "wet" and the "wavy".

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE COURTYARD - DAY

The people of the empire gather in the courtyard, their faces a mix of confusion and wonder. They gaze upon the transformed castle, the neon tapestries, and the distorted images of the empire's crest.

REGINALD
(to the crowd)
Behold! The future is here! (he raises his arms, and the crowd erupts into cheers and applause)

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
